items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 35:1
items.html: All the NHY divide into three thirds, as is known. And the NHY of AA all illuminate only in Beriah, but in the world of Yetzirah there are only the two lower thirds of the NHY, which are the middle and the lower [thirds]. And the upper discernment of the NHY of AA, that is, the upper thirds of its NHY, were drawn to Yetzirah only as the discernment of a garment for the middle thirds of the NHY of Atik, and not from the discernment of AA himself. Therefore they became a revealed head, because only Atik clothes in them, as above in answer 33, see there. (Item 228).
